name: myatriumhealth-mcp
description: Read MyAtriumHealth (Atrium Health's Epic MyChart patient portal) — test results, medications, allergies, immunizations, health issues and visits — through your signed-in browser tab.

tools.name: mah_auth_status
tools.description: Report whether a stored session can be resumed and whether verification is pending

tools.name: mah_get_health_summary
tools.description: Fetch the health-summary header and action plans

tools.name: mah_healthcheck
tools.description: Report which hop is broken: the browser bridge when relaying, or the credential and session when signing in server-side

tools.name: mah_list_allergies
tools.description: List allergies and their reactions from the health summary

tools.name: mah_list_billing_accounts
tools.description: List billing accounts and balances due, parsed from the server-rendered billing page

tools.name: mah_list_care_team
tools.description: List care team providers with specialty and relationship, internal and external

tools.name: mah_list_goals
tools.description: List patient goals tracked in MyAtriumHealth

tools.name: mah_list_health_issues
tools.description: List the problem list (current health issues)

tools.name: mah_list_immunizations
tools.description: List immunizations and administration dates by organization

tools.name: mah_list_insurance
tools.description: List insurance coverages on file, including pending and in-review coverages

tools.name: mah_list_medications
tools.description: List current medications with dosing instructions and prescriber

tools.name: mah_list_message_folders
tools.description: List Message Center folders with unread and total counts

tools.name: mah_list_messages
tools.description: List Message Center conversations for a folder, with the conversationId to reply to, participants, subject and date

tools.name: mah_reply_message
tools.description: Reply to a Message Center conversation as the active patient. Irreversible and provider-visible; asks the user to confirm first (a prompt where the client supports one, otherwise a preview and a confirmToken). Refused when MAH_READ_ONLY is set.

tools.name: mah_list_past_visits
tools.description: List past visits grouped by organization

tools.name: mah_list_test_results
tools.description: List lab and imaging results with abnormal flags and provider comments

tools.name: mah_list_upcoming_visits
tools.description: List upcoming and in-progress appointments

tools.name: mah_send_verification_code
tools.description: Ask the portal to send a verification code to the account holder

tools.name: mah_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in server-side; reports the verification channels when a code is required

tools.name: mah_verify_code
tools.description: Submit the code the user received; stores the session so restarts resume

tools.name: mah_list_patients
tools.description: List the patients this login can open: the account holder plus anyone who granted proxy access.

tools.name: mah_get_patient_context
tools.description: Report which patient the reading tools are currently returning data for.

tools.name: mah_set_active_patient
tools.description: Point every reading tool at one of the patients from mah_list_patients.

mah_username.title: Username (bridge-less mode)
mah_username.description: MyAtriumHealth username. Set with MAH_PASSWORD to enable bridge-less mode. Leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

mah_password.title: Password (bridge-less mode)
mah_password.description: Portal password. Both are required; setting only one falls back to the bridge (with a warning).

mah_dotenv.title: Credentials .env file (optional)
mah_dotenv.description: Path to a .env file read first; failing that ~/.myatriumhealth-mcp/.env, then ./.env. A real MAH_USERNAME / MAH_PASSWORD in the environment always wins.

mah_device_file.title: Session state file (optional)
mah_device_file.description: Session state (0600), default ~/.myatriumhealth-mcp/device.json. Holds the live cookie jar as well as the device token — treat as a credential.

mah_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
mah_ws_port.description: fetchproxy concentrator port (bridge mode only, default 37149). The whole fleet shares this one port; override only when hosting.

mah_read_only.title: Read-only (refuse replies)
mah_read_only.description: true refuses mah_reply_message sends (previews still work). The tool stays listed either way. Default false.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
